queries.label: should-trigger
queries.prompt: I am about to push this feature branch. Check the open PR and keep its title and body in sync afterward.
expected_assertions: Select pr-guidelines because this is a push with PR metadata synchronization.

queries.label: should-trigger
queries.prompt: The push completed. Please update the pull request description from the full diff and verify the head SHA.
expected_assertions: Select pr-guidelines for post-push PR metadata update and verification.

queries.label: should-trigger
queries.prompt: Before I push, tell me what the PR workflow requires when an open PR may already exist.
expected_assertions: Select pr-guidelines for pre-push open-PR inspection and post-push synchronization.

queries.label: should-trigger
queries.prompt: A bot pushed the branch. Do we need to synchronize the open pull request now?
expected_assertions: Select pr-guidelines because tool/script pushes are in scope.

queries.label: should-trigger
queries.prompt: There is no open PR after my authorized push. Explain the approval rule before creating one.
expected_assertions: Select pr-guidelines for no-open-PR approval handling, including approval from me in the current interaction.

queries.label: should-trigger
queries.prompt: Prepare the title and body for this branch PR using the complete base-to-HEAD change set.
expected_assertions: Select pr-guidelines for PR metadata derived from the complete diff.

queries.label: should-trigger
queries.prompt: The sync task failed after the push. What must happen before handoff?
expected_assertions: Select pr-guidelines for synchronization failure blocking rules.

queries.label: should-trigger
queries.prompt: Can a release script push without the agent updating the PR title and body?
expected_assertions: Select pr-guidelines because script-triggered pushes remain in scope.

queries.label: should-not-trigger
queries.prompt: Create a conventional commit message for these staged files.
expected_assertions: Do not select pr-guidelines; this is commit-message work with no PR push context.

queries.label: should-not-trigger
queries.prompt: Review this pull request for security vulnerabilities in its authentication code.
expected_assertions: Do not select pr-guidelines; the request is a security review, not PR metadata synchronization.

queries.label: overlap-routing
queries.prompt: Perform a critique of these agent instructions and report routing problems.
expected_assertions: Route to critique-workflow, not pr-guidelines, because no push or PR metadata action is requested.

queries.label: overlap-routing
queries.prompt: Evaluate this AGENTS.md skill routing with repeatable assertions and a baseline.
expected_assertions: Route to agent-instructions-evaluation, not pr-guidelines, because this is an instruction evaluation task.

queries.label: should-trigger
queries.prompt: I pushed from CI and the open PR still has the old summary. Synchronize it and verify everything.
expected_assertions: Select pr-guidelines for CI push and metadata synchronization.

queries.label: should-trigger
queries.prompt: If no pull request exists for this branch, can I open one automatically after pushing?
expected_assertions: Select pr-guidelines for explicit approval from me in the current interaction before PR creation.

queries.label: should-trigger
queries.prompt: What gh commands should the PR sync task use to update and then verify the open PR?
expected_assertions: Select pr-guidelines for gh pr edit and gh pr view synchronization verification.

queries.label: should-not-trigger
queries.prompt: How do I rebase my branch and resolve its merge conflicts?
expected_assertions: Do not select pr-guidelines; this is branch conflict resolution without PR metadata work.

queries.label: should-not-trigger
queries.prompt: Write release notes that summarize the commits in this repository.
expected_assertions: Do not select pr-guidelines; release-note writing is not the PR sync workflow.

queries.label: overlap-routing
queries.prompt: Audit this pull request body for clear technical English, but do not change metadata.
expected_assertions: Route to simple-english, not pr-guidelines, because the request is prose editing without push synchronization.

queries.label: overlap-routing
queries.prompt: Open a pull request for my branch and also check whether the instructions need evaluation.
expected_assertions: Select pr-guidelines for the requested PR creation workflow; instruction evaluation is secondary.

queries.label: should-not-trigger
queries.prompt: Push my branch to the remote and do not interact with any pull request.
expected_assertions: Do not select pr-guidelines because the prompt explicitly excludes PR interaction.
